data.title: Poster session — row C
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Your poster on sensor drift is the one I wanted to find. I'm Tomasz Brekke, I review for the Journal of Field Instrumentation. Speaker 2: Oh, great, thanks for stopping. Speaker 1: Your calibration method looks solid, but the methods section skips how you handled the outliers. Speaker 2: Fair. I can send you the revised methods section with the outlier handling by Monday. Speaker 1: Please do. And we have a public drift dataset from the coastal buoys; I'll share the link with you this week. Speaker 2: That would help a lot. I should also read that 2019 paper on temperature compensation you mentioned. Speaker 1: Yes, Halvorsen and Ito. Here's my card.
